member.name: P:bolt.module.auth.verbs.AuthVerbBase.IsErpEnhancementsEnabled
member.summary: True when the erpPacToolEnhancements feature flag is enabled. Gates ERP-aware UI surfaces in the auth verbs (extra ERP URL column in 'pac auth list', lazy hint, "Linked F&O detected" message in 'pac auth create', etc.) so customers on the flag-off path see the unchanged auth experience.

member.name: M:bolt.module.auth.verbs.AuthVerbBase.AnyProfileHasErpUrl
member.summary: Returns true if any profile in the current auth-profile manager is F&O-linked (i.e. has an ErpUrl set) AND the erpPacToolEnhancements feature flag is enabled. Callers use this to decide whether to surface the lazy-F&O-token hint in list-style output. The flag gate also hides any stale ErpUrl persisted from a prior flag-on session when the flag is currently off.
